title: Default TFR Questionnaire
description: Default file review questionnaire for validating documentation, estimate support, and repair-scope opportunities.

questions.text: Was the file documentation sufficient to support the estimate decision?

sub_questions.text: Documentation is missing, incomplete, or insufficient to support the estimate decision.
sub_questions.reasoning: The file lacks sufficient visual documentation and detailed estimate line items to justify the scope selected; specific missing items include adequate before/after photos and support for each repair line.
sub_questions.citations: (Fictitious evidence: claim folder notes indicate photos are limited; estimate summary does not include supporting line-item justification; attachment section shows missing photo set.)
sub_questions.help_text: Cite the missing or insufficient notes, photos, estimate details, or attachments.

questions.help_text: Review notes, photos, estimate line items, and supporting attachments.

questions.text: Were all applicable repair opportunities addressed?

sub_questions.text: An applicable repair item appears missing or under-scoped.
sub_questions.reasoning: An identified damage area appears not addressed in the estimate scope, indicating at least one repair opportunity is missing or under-scoped.
sub_questions.citations: (Fictitious evidence: inspection notes reference additional panel/trim repair; estimate totals exclude that referenced component; photo review indicates corresponding defect.)
sub_questions.help_text: Cite the file evidence that supports the opportunity.

outcome_justification: The estimate decision is not fully supported by the available file documentation, and an applicable repair opportunity appears missing or under-scoped based on inspection notes and the photo review.
